records.jp: まずは、ここが――<CR>この世界が何なのかを話す必要がある
records.en_original: We should start off by talking about this place—about what this world is.
records.en_auxiliary: We should start off by talking about this place—about what this world is.
records.en: First, I need to explain<CR>what this world is.

records.jp: そう、それが一番気になってたんだよ
records.en_original: That's what I'm most curious about.
records.en_auxiliary: That's what I'm most curious about.
records.en: That's what I'm most curious about.

records.jp: ここは、世界の崩壊からみんなを守るために<CR>作られたシェルター……一時避難場所だよ
records.en_original: This world is a shelter built to protect you from the end of the world. A temporary evacuation shelter.
records.en_auxiliary: This world is a shelter built to protect you from the end of the world. A temporary evacuation shelter.
records.en: This is a shelter built to protect everyone<CR>from the collapse of the world...a temporary refuge.

records.jp: 世界の……崩壊？
records.en_original: The end of the world...?
records.en_auxiliary: The end of the world...?
records.en: The end of the world...?

records.jp: そう。何らかの理由で、<CR>元々私たちが住んでいた世界は危機に瀕していた
records.en_original: Yes. The world where we resided was on the brink of catastrophe.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. The world where we resided was on the brink of catastrophe.
records.en: Yes. For some reason,<CR>the world we originally lived in was in danger.

records.jp: それって、例の“灰”でってこと！？
records.en_original: Was it because of that Ash stuff?!
records.en_auxiliary: Was it because of that Ash stuff?!
records.en: Was it because of that Ash stuff?!

records.jp: ……分からない。<CR>私も元の世界の記憶はなくて……
records.en_original: I don't know. I've lost my memory from the real world, too.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know. I've lost my memory from the real world, too.
records.en: ...I don't know.<CR>I have no memories of the original world either...

records.jp: あなたたちが知らないこの世界の情報を<CR>いくつか知っている。それだけ
records.en_original: I only happen to know some things that you don't, that's all.
records.en_auxiliary: I only happen to know some things that you don't, that's all.
records.en: I only know several things about this world<CR>that you do not. That is all.

records.jp: （……そっか。今は、私のことも覚えてないんだ）
records.en_original: (That's right... She doesn't remember me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's right... She doesn't remember me.)
records.en: (That's right... She doesn't remember me.)

records.jp: なんでユズさんはそれを知ってるの……？
records.en_original: But how do you know all this?
records.en_auxiliary: But how do you know all this?
records.en: Why do you know all this, Yuzu-san...?

records.jp: 簡単な話。この世界は――<CR>私とライムが作ったものだから
records.en_original: That's simple. This world was created by Lime and I.
records.en_auxiliary: That's simple. This world was created by Lime and I.
records.en: The answer is simple. This world—<CR>was created by Lime and me.

records.jp: えっ――
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: ユズたちって神様だったの！？
records.en_original: You guys are like, gods or something?!
records.en_auxiliary: You guys are like, gods or something?!
records.en: Were you two gods?!

records.jp: 説明すると長くなるけど……<CR>魂の管理者、くらいに思ってもらえればいい
records.en_original: It's a long story... Just think of us as soul wardens.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a long story... Just think of us as soul wardens.
records.en: It would take a long time to explain...<CR>Think of us as administrators of souls.

records.jp: 魂の管理者……
records.en_original: Soul wardens...
records.en_auxiliary: Soul wardens...
records.en: Soul wardens...

records.jp: あなたたちリフレクターは、指輪を通して<CR>私たちが管理する世界と繋がっていた
records.en_original: Through your rings, you Reflectors are connected to this world we have created.
records.en_auxiliary: Through your rings, you Reflectors are connected to this world we have created.
records.en: Through your rings, you Reflectors were connected<CR>to the world under our management.

records.jp: 私たちはそれを通して、記憶と引き換えに<CR>あなたたちの周りに球状の壁を作った
records.en_original: Using those rings, we created a barrier that surrounds you in exchange for your memories.
records.en_auxiliary: Using those rings, we created a barrier that surrounds you in exchange for your memories.
records.en: Through that connection, in exchange for your memories,<CR>we created a spherical wall around you.

records.jp: そうして出来上がったのがこの世界。<CR>宇宙に浮かぶ雫のような、小さな世界
records.en_original: And that's how we created this tiny little world. A small safe haven, floating through the universe.
records.en_auxiliary: And that's how we created this tiny little world. A small safe haven, floating through the universe.
records.en: That is how this world was formed:<CR>a tiny world like a droplet floating in space.

records.jp: 雫のような世界……
records.en_original: A safe haven...
records.en_auxiliary: A safe haven...
records.en: A world like a droplet...

records.jp: “雫世界”……か
records.en_original: Like an oasis...
records.en_auxiliary: Like an oasis...
records.en: "Oasis"...huh.

records.jp: 良い名前。<CR>その雫世界で、私たちは生きているの
records.en_original: That's a good name. Now we're living on that Oasis.
records.en_auxiliary: That's a good name. Now we're living on that Oasis.
records.en: A good name.<CR>We are living in that Oasis.

records.jp: それって、つまり――
records.en_original: So you're saying—
records.en_auxiliary: So you're saying—
records.en: So you're saying—

records.jp: 世界に灰が降って人類が滅びかけた。<CR>それを知ったユズさんたちがヤバいと思って……
records.en_original: Yuzu and Lime realized the Ash was going to destroy humanity. So...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu and Lime realized the Ash was going to destroy humanity. So...
records.en: Ash fell across the world and humanity nearly went extinct.<CR>Yuzu-san and Lime learned that and realized the danger...

records.jp: わたしたちリフレクターを集めて、壁の中にかくまった
records.en_original: They gathered us Reflectors together and enclosed us within these walls.
records.en_auxiliary: They gathered us Reflectors together and enclosed us within these walls.
records.en: So they gathered us Reflectors and sheltered us within the wall.

records.jp: さっきの“クラック”が<CR>その壁が割れたってことを意味するなら――
records.en_original: So the Crack earlier was a fracture in the barrier?
records.en_auxiliary: So the Crack earlier was a fracture in the barrier?
records.en: If that "Crack" meant<CR>the wall had fractured—

records.jp: そ、外の世界にはあんなヤバそうな怪物が<CR>うようよ歩いてるってこと！？
records.en_original: Th-then the outside world is full of those scary monsters?!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-then the outside world is full of those scary monsters?!
records.en: Th-then the outside world is crawling<CR>with terrifying monsters like that?!

records.jp: 今あなたたちの持っている情報と照らし合わせると、<CR>それが一番自然に思える
records.en_original: Considering the information we have, I think that it's likely.
records.en_auxiliary: Considering the information we have, I think that it's likely.
records.en: Comparing that with the information you have,<CR>it seems the most natural conclusion.

records.jp: この世界も、無限に維持し続けられるわけじゃない。<CR>均衡が崩れれば消え去ってしまう可能性はある
records.en_original: This world can't be sustained forever. It may disappear if its balance is lost.
records.en_auxiliary: This world can't be sustained forever. It may disappear if its balance is lost.
records.en: This world cannot be maintained forever.<CR>If its balance collapses, it may disappear.

records.jp: それこそ、さっきのクラックのようなことがあれば……
records.en_original: That's why, if another Crack like the one before was to happen...
records.en_auxiliary: That's why, if another Crack like the one before was to happen...
records.en: Especially if something like that Crack happens...

records.jp: いつまでもここに<CR>留まってるわけにもいかないってことか……
records.en_original: So we won't be able to stay here forever...
records.en_auxiliary: So we won't be able to stay here forever...
records.en: So we cannot<CR>remain here forever...

records.jp: でも、ただ外に出るだけじゃダメなんでしょ？<CR>灰を止めるとかしないと、生きていけないんじゃ――
records.en_original: But there's no way we can go outside, right? As long as the Ash is falling, living out there is...
records.en_auxiliary: But there's no way we can go outside, right? As long as the Ash is falling, living out there is...
records.en: But simply going outside is not enough, right?<CR>We cannot live unless we stop the Ash or something—

records.jp: 安全に元の世界に戻るにはどうすればいいか、<CR>私も一人でずっと考えていた
records.en_original: I've thought a lot about how to make the world safe to return to.
records.en_auxiliary: I've thought a lot about how to make the world safe to return to.
records.en: I have been thinking alone about<CR>how we can safely return to the original world.

records.jp: でも私は、雫世界の創造主として<CR>あなたたちを守る義務もある
records.en_original: But as a creator of the Oasis, it is my duty to protect you all.
records.en_auxiliary: But as a creator of the Oasis, it is my duty to protect you all.
records.en: But as a creator of Oasis,<CR>I also have a duty to protect you.

records.jp: これまでは、極力リスクを避けて<CR>一人で行動してきたけど……
records.en_original: Up until now, I've been trying to work alone and avoid as much risk as possible.
records.en_auxiliary: Up until now, I've been trying to work alone and avoid as much risk as possible.
records.en: Until now, I acted alone<CR>to avoid as much risk as possible...

records.jp: クラックのような事態が起きている以上、<CR>リスクを回避し続けることも厳しいかもしれない
records.en_original: But if things like Cracks continue to happen, then I don't think that approach will work anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: But if things like Cracks continue to happen, then I don't think that approach will work anymore.
records.en: But with events like the Crack occurring,<CR>we may no longer be able to keep avoiding risk.

records.jp: 協力しようよ！<CR>私たちも、元の世界に戻りたいのは同じだからさ
records.en_original: We should work together! All of us want to get back to the our world, right?
records.en_auxiliary: We should work together! All of us want to get back to the our world, right?
records.en: Let us work together!<CR>We all want to return to the original world.

records.jp: ……分かった
records.en_original: ...I understand.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I understand.
records.en: ...I understand.

records.jp: みんな、ついて来て。<CR>これから、ココロトープに行く
records.en_original: Everyone, follow me. We're going to the Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone, follow me. We're going to the Heartscape.
records.en: Everyone, follow me.<CR>We are going to a Heartscape.

records.jp: 誰のココロトープに行くの？
records.en_original: Whose Heartscape?
records.en_auxiliary: Whose Heartscape?
records.en: Whose Heartscape?

records.jp: 私たち
records.en_original: Ours.
records.en_auxiliary: Ours.
records.en: Ours.

records.jp: 私、たち……？
records.en_original: Ours...?
records.en_auxiliary: Ours...?
records.en: Ours...?

records.jp: 今から……私と、ライムのココロトープに行く
records.en_original: Lime's and mine.
records.en_auxiliary: Lime's and mine.
records.en: We are going to...Lime's and my Heartscape.
